modern: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements. But the motion of virtue is in none of these: it is something more divine, and, advancing by a way hardly noticed, it goes happily on its road.
original: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements. But the motion of virtue is in none of these: it is something more divine, and advancing by a way hardly observed, it goes happily on its road.
notification: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements.
notification_original: Above, below, all around are the movements of the elements.

explained.summary: The elements swirl all around us, above and below. But virtue doesn’t move like they do. Its progress is something more divine: it travels a path that is barely noticed, and it goes happily on its way. Being good rarely looks dramatic from the outside.
